calculation.description: Measure acceleration of 20-session momentum relative to the average 60-session trend, then normalize by downside realized volatility. Downside volatility is the 30-session standard deviation of negative daily returns, annualized; a small realized-volatility floor improves numerical stability and coverage. The complete signal is lagged one session before forward-return testing. Higher values indicate stronger risk-adjusted recent acceleration.

validation.regime_notes: Full-sample daily paper IC and ICIR narrowly pass the benchmark gates, with broad average coverage across the 15-asset universe. Predictive power is strong over the latest 365 observations but negative over 750 and 1260 observations, indicating substantial regime dependence and requiring conservative ensemble weighting and prompt revalidation. Cross-sectional uncertainty remains material with only 15 instruments.
